title: hieracium cirritum subsp. biceps
intro: Hieracium cirritum subsp. biceps, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a plant species in the sunflower family known for its medicinal properties. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. Therapeutically, Hawkweed is used to treat various conditions, including skin irritations, wounds, and infections, due to its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The health benefits of Hawkweed are attributed to its ability to soothe and protect the skin, promoting healing and preventing infection.
